it places policies rather than managing investments."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Investment manager earning asset-based fees from funds and separate accounts sold to institutions and individuals."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Investment manager earning advisory fees on funds and separate accounts for institutions and individual investors."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Regulatory filing software and document services for corporate issuers, not investment management."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Alternative asset manager earning management and performance fees from institutional investors, similar to the target's affiliates."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Core business is research, ratings and data sold by subscription; its portfolio management is a minor line."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Private markets investment manager earning management fees on funds, though its lending business differs from the target."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Core business is investment processing software and outsourced operations; fund management is secondary."},{"label":"C11","good":true,"reason":"Fee-based investment manager running separate accounts and funds for wealthy clients and institutions, matching the target's fee model."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Core business is financial software and outsourced back-office services, not managing investment products."},{"label":"C13","good":true,"reason":"Affiliated boutique multi-manager selling funds and separate accounts through advisers and institutions, closest to the target."},{"label":"C14","good":true,"reason":"Fund sponsor earning management fees on ETFs and active funds sold to advisers and investors, with a minor tokenization line."}]}
